Semantics of typeid (expr.typeid)

typeid is an lvalue of type const std::type_info (<https://eel.is/c++draft/expr.typeid1>). cpp2v prints its operand as [inl ty] when the result is fixed at compile time (a type, or an unevaluated expression), with [ty] canonical and free of references and top-level cv-qualifiers ([expr.typeid]/5-7), and as [inr e] for a glvalue [e] of polymorphic class type ([expr.typeid]/4), whose dynamic type is read from [derivationR] (see [with_mdc]). <> of a null polymorphic glvalue throws <> ([expr.typeid]/3); that case has no rule, as no [derivationR] exists for it. Both rules are [UNSUPPORTED] on types outside [typeid_ok]. [specs/type_info.v] specifies <>.

The types that type_infoR identifies

type_infoR identifies types by syntactic equality on type (see the std::type_info::operator== spec in specs/type_info.v). That is sound only on C++ types that cpp2v prints in exactly one way (the canonical form, never a reference or top-level cv-qualified type), and that no other C++ type prints like, in any translation unit.
typeid_ok ty is a conservative allowlist of such printed types: both typeid rules are UNSUPPORTED on other types. It accepts
  • builtin arithmetic, character, bool, void and std::nullptr_t types;
  • classes and enumerations whose name is built only from identifiers (Nid) of namespaces and classes, possibly instantiating templates with arguments that are themselves accepted types, or integer constants of integral or accepted enumeration type;
  • pointers to accepted types, which may be const and/or volatile unless they are arrays;
  • arrays of accepted types (hence with unqualified elements).
It rejects, among others, the following types, where printing is not injective or not canonical:
  • function types, anywhere: cpp2v drops exception specifications, and function_type_ has no cv- or ref-qualifiers for member functions, so typeid(void( * )() noexcept) and typeid(void( * )()) would print the same, as would the types of &S::g and &S::h for a const member function g and a non-const h;
  • member pointers;
  • names under an anonymous namespace (Nanonymous), which print alike in every translation unit; names of local classes, which are scoped by their function's name (Nfunction), that a static function in another translation unit may share; unnamed classes and enumerations (Nanon, Nfirst_decl, Nfirst_child); and other names such as Ndependent or Nunsupported;
  • references and top-level cv-qualifiers (expr.typeid/6-7): cpp2v removes them, so a hand-built Etypeid (inl (Tqualified QC Tint)) would compare unequal to typeid(int);
  • dependent, unsupported, attributed, realigned and architecture-specific types, and any other type constructor.
Fixpoint typeid_ok (ty : type) : bool :=
  match ty with
  | Tnum _ _ | Tchar_ _ | Tbool | Tvoid | Tnullptr | Tfloat_ _ => true
  | Tnamed n | Tenum n => typeid_ok_name n
  | Tptr (Tqualified QM _) => false
  | Tptr (Tqualified _ (Tarray _ _)) => false
  | Tptr (Tqualified _ t) | Tptr t => typeid_ok t
  | Tarray t _ => typeid_ok t
  | _ => false
  end
with typeid_ok_name (n : name) : bool :=
  match n with
  | Nglobal (Nid _) => true
  | Nscoped n (Nid _) => typeid_ok_name n
  | Ninst n args => typeid_ok_name n && forallb typeid_ok_arg args
  | _ => false
  end
with typeid_ok_arg (a : temp_arg) : bool :=
  match a with
  | Atype t => typeid_ok t
  | Avalue (Eint _ (Tnum _ _ | Tchar_ _ | Tbool)) => true
  | Avalue (Eint _ (Tenum n)) => typeid_ok_name n
  | _ => false
  end.

Module Type Expr__typeid.

p |-> type_infoR ty: p is a std::type_info object that represents the type ty. std::type_info objects have static storage duration and are never modified, hence Persistent. Several objects may represent the same type (expr.typeid/1 does not promise one object per type).
  Parameter type_infoR : forall `{Σ : cpp_logic} {σ : genv}, type -> Rep.

  Section with_resolve.
    Context `{Σ : cpp_logic} {resolve : genv}.

    #[global] Declare Instance type_infoR_persistent ty : Persistent (type_infoR ty).
    #[global] Declare Instance type_infoR_affine ty : Affine (type_infoR ty).

    Variables (tu : translation_unit) (ρ : region).

    #[local] Notation wp_lval := (wp_lval tu ρ).
    #[local] Notation wp_glval := (wp_glval tu ρ).

A type, or an expression that is not evaluated (expr.typeid/5-7). The rule is UNSUPPORTED on types outside typeid_ok.
    Axiom wp_lval_typeid_type : forall ty t Q,
          (if typeid_ok ty
           then Forall p : ptr, p |-> type_infoR ty -* Q p FreeTemps.id
           else UNSUPPORTED ("typeid: type outside typeid_ok", ty))
      |-- wp_lval (Etypeid (inl ty) t) Q.

A glvalue of polymorphic class type (expr.typeid/4): the type of the most-derived object, if it is in typeid_ok (for instance, not a local class).
    Axiom wp_lval_typeid_expr : forall e t Q,
      match drop_qualifiers (type_of e) with
      | Tnamed cls =>
          wp_glval e (fun p free =>
            with_mdc p cls (fun mdc =>
              match mdc with
              | most_derived :: _ =>
                  if typeid_ok (Tnamed most_derived)
                  then Forall ti : ptr, ti |-> type_infoR (Tnamed most_derived) -* Q ti free
                  else UNSUPPORTED ("typeid: dynamic type outside typeid_ok", most_derived)
              | [] => UNREACHABLE "typeid: empty most-derived path"
              end))
      | _ => ERROR "typeid: polymorphic operand of non-class type"
      end
      |-- wp_lval (Etypeid (inr e) t) Q.
  End with_resolve.
End Expr__typeid.
